newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Nam Fong seen to issue 340 mln shares - sources.
newsitem.headline: HK's Nam Fong seen to issue 340 mln shares - sources.

text.p: Nam Fong International Holdings Ltd, a Hong Kong-incorporated China property development group, was expected to issue 340 million shares to raise between HK$850 million and HK$1,020 million, market sources said on Tuesday.
The shares were expected to be priced between HK$2.50 and HK$3.00 per share, representing a prospective price to earnings multiple of 6.7 to 8.1 times, sources said.
The issue could also give a 30 to 40 percent discount to the company's net asset value per share.
From the proceeds, HK$484 million was expected to fund property investment and acquisition, and the balance used as general working capital, they said.
Some 80 percent of the issue or 272 million shares would be for international placement and the remaining 20 percent or 68 million shares for initial public offering in Hong Kong.
The flotation in Hong Kong was expected to run from November 26 to 29 and dealing in the shares was expected to begin on December 9, sources added.
The China-backed Nam Fong International currently holds 10 development and two property investment projects, giving a total gross floor area of 1.249 million square metres, sources said.
The properties which comprise residential and shopping arcade, are mainly located in Guangzhou, in China's southern province of Guangdong, sources said.
Jardine Fleming is expected to be the sponsor of the issue, market sources said.
